observations: Yellow gas cylinder with black burner assembly.
Brand 'GASLAND' is visible on the bottom of the cylinder in photo 0 and photo 2.
Brand 'ZEN GAZ' is visible on the side of the cylinder in photo 1.
The cylinder shows significant surface wear, dirt, and scuff marks.
A 'EXTREME FLAMMABLE' warning symbol is visible on the side in photo 1.
The burner assembly appears to be a standard 2-burner design.
The cylinder is resting on a blue plastic barrel.

claims.evidence: Subjective term; quality cannot be determined from photos alone.
The capacity is not visible on the cylinder in the provided photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be past its expiry date or near the end of its service life.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamped on the metal shroud or handle.

risks.risk: The valve may be damaged or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the valve assembly and a video of it being operated.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than intended.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder's weight stamp or a video showing the valve being opened.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamp on the cylinder.
Close-up photo of the valve assembly.
Video of the cylinder being filled or the valve being operated.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
